protocol_configuration.episode_end: true done or step limit; preserve actual length

shared_collector.identity: original full baseline, not an Ours switch configuration
shared_collector.action_postprocessing: add independent Gaussian noise, clip, then map to physical action

bank.consumers: all methods and training seeds, read-only

preprocessing.obs_and_next_obs: normalize exactly once in method adapter
preprocessing.training_normalizer_mismatch: block compatibility until provenance and contract are resolved

inference.representation: posterior mean or native deterministic latent
inference.policy_condition: native posterior mechanism with isolated RNG

seeding.algorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON array with separators=(',',':'), first 4 bytes big-endian

statistics.missing_seed: incomplete; never nanmean as a complete four-seed result

probe.context_train_val: 20 independent contexts per seen task per split, length 200
probe.loss: reward standardized MSE + mean-dimension delta-state standardized MSE
probe.selection: minimum seen-validation mean loss, earlier on ties
probe.latent_normalizer_fit: seen probe_train contexts only, per model
probe.target_normalizer_fit: seen train queries only, shared across methods
probe.test_pairs_per_task: 20 B contexts x 1000 test queries, batched
probe.H0: state-action-only diagnostic predictor; same budget and seeds; not an RL baseline or component ablation

visualization.tasks: first 4 seen and first 4 unseen sorted by manifest task id
visualization.projection_scope: one joint projection per method/environment/training seed

stage_gates.A: strict model loading and real reset/step for every method/environment on same 1 task x 2 contexts x 1 rollout smoke bank
stage_gates.B: 2000 contexts/env; 6000 episodes/method/seed/env; all 4 seeds; hashes and completion keys verified
stage_gates.C: no unseen training/tuning; no trajectory overlap; shared query files; training-only statistics
stage_gates.D: figures redrawable from saved latents/config; tables recomputable from episode/task records

deviations.authority: explicit user instruction before formal diagnostics
deviations.change: Replace the single Ours entry with two separately reported complete methods, Ours-local and Ours-global
deviations.reason: User chose both full Ours versions and the GENTLE run; all eight entries share the same raw context bank
deviations.prior_artifacts: v1 resource audit retained read-only as discovery evidence; no formal v1 results exist

note: Discovery evidence only. No method assignment or stage completion. Do not copy weights.
